title: Core: F6 insertKeyframe shallow-copies displayObjects despite deep-copy contract (aliasing hazard)
description: packages/core/src/model/timeline.ts:383-385 comment says 'Deep-copy the displayObjects so the new keyframe is independent' but code does governing.displayObjects.map(o => ({...o})) — a shallow clone. Nested shape.paths, filters, colorEffect, warp stay shared by reference between source and new keyframe. The immutable-model convention mostly protects this, but any in-place mutation of a shape's nested arrays, or code relying on the two keyframes being truly independent for a shape tween's start/end, corrupts both keyframes. Latent aliasing hazard, not a live crash. Fix: deep-clone nested geometry/effect objects (or document the shared-reference invariant). Confidence: confirmed vs stated contract; real-world trigger needs a mutating caller.
